scope: Current Curify frontend catalog, including text-only and reference-image workflows

source_evidence.method: Inspected IDs, English titles/descriptions, input parameters, upload requirements, and adjacent examples; keyword hits were manually checked for operation and output compatibility.

scope_rule: A capability is unsupported when no current template can produce the requested functional artifact. Visual lookalikes, nonfunctional mockups, and workflows requiring a missing reference image do not make a text-only request supported.

capability_checks.rationale: The retouching blueprint requires an uploaded portrait and the vintage passport poster is a decorative profile layout, not a biometric official photo. Production planning explicitly blocks text-only ID-photo generation.
No resume or CV document-layout generator was found.
No app wireframe or dashboard UI generator was found; a systems-architecture diagram is a different information structure.
Brand mockups may depict stationery, but no seating-assignment artifact or ticket with a functional scannable QR-code contract exists.
A visual mockup cannot guarantee a working QR payload or ticketing function.
No tattoo or transfer-stencil generator was found.
Adjacent templates make illustrative architecture or concept sketches, not measured floor plans suitable as technical drawings.
A fashion concept sheet is not a printable, measured garment pattern.
Recipe and packaging templates do not produce restaurant menus with prices and allergen codes.
No measured full-wrap book cover with spine and bleed controls was found.
A music infographic is not podcast or album cover artwork with platform/package specifications.
No organization chart with reporting-line semantics was found.
No template accepts tabular data and guarantees an accurate plot from specified columns.
No editable slide-master or presentation-deck output exists in the image-template catalog.
Craft tutorials do not provide stitch-accurate knitting charts.
The catalog produces still images, not transparent video logo animation.
A rendered concept image is not a watertight, dimensionally usable STL model.
